items.title: Introducing ChatGPT search
items.summary: Get fast, timely answers with links to relevant web sources

items.title: Promega’s top-down adoption of ChatGPT accelerates manufacturing, sales, and marketing
items.summary: Promega's top-down adoption of ChatGPT accelerates manufacturing, sales, and marketing
